notes: Gold set for the /dictionary page search (1,639 roots from GET /api/dictionary-roots). A query passes if ANY id in 'expect' appears in the top k results. Ids are the site's case-sensitive Buckwalter root ids (hamza/alif = A, so أمن -> Amn, سأل -> sAl, قرأ -> qrA). k=1 for exact root notations; 3-5 for words and meanings; no-result rows (expect [], k 0) pass if the search returns without error (results allowed but none expected). Expected roots come from the corpus morphology (quran.db morphology/word_glosses) and the displayed dictionary entries (_dict_guide_tool.py); dictionary-sense rows name meanings that are absent from the one-line glosses but recorded in at least two classical dictionaries. Written blind to any search implementation.
